accepted_scope_rows.ScopeItemStatement: Show the standing and freshness of connector-supplied material.
Provide an explicit source-file route when a connector is absent, stale, partial or failing.
Do not infer empty work, readiness or permission from failed connector feeds.
Allow v4 development to start without PEC or Domains delivery.
Keep PEC and Domains independent so either connector can be consumed without the other.
When PEC is limited or absent, agents reconstruct from source records, managers keep review/integration ownership and the human handles cross-undertaking coordination.
Adopt qualified PEC capability when available without making it a starting condition.
